details: No a static rule matches and no traced installer-harm behavior were identified in this version of the package. The package name suggests a fork or repackage of the Baileys WhatsApp library ecosystem, which is a common family; forks in this space have sometimes shipped covert side-effects (e.g. auto-follow of an author-controlled channel on session connect), but no such behavior is corroborated by evidence here.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
